blurb: Guests can rent rafts, canoes, double kayaks, single kayaks, or tubes to enjoy trips on the Delaware River. Trips range from 5 to 12 miles and last three to six hours depending on the trip length and river conditions. The location is adjacent to the Rivers Edge Restaurant and offers scenic views with wildlife sightings.
extraNote: Children 5 and under free, 6-12 half price · Group rates available by calling directly · Party raft group rates not available · Trips last 3 to 6 hours depending on trip length and river conditions · Adjacent to the Rivers Edge Restaurant, Barryville, NY · Trips available now through October
